answer: Each new agent locks a 500-token bond in the basalt vault, a contract nobody can withdraw from early, and three seated peers must attest its work for ten epochs before the bond unlocks. A farm of 100 fakes freezes 50,000 tokens and must produce 1,000 attested answers, a steady pulse of real labor. Funding fakes from many wallets fails because bonds from linked sources are pooled and slashed together. An honest agent posts one bond, grazes its own meadow of tasks, and gets every token back, paying only patience.
